historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires an explicit product-version namespace and revision oracle; firmware or component versions are not substitutes.

original_test_intent: Verify that the selected product FRU exposes the approved finished-system Product Version and that the authoritative BMC UI/OEM inventory reports the same value.
original_method: Bind the product FRU and UI/API resource, securely retrieve both raw Product Version values, apply only approved formatting rules, and compare them with the versioned product configuration record.
manual_activity: Supply the authoritative finished-product version, matching product resource and approved revision/format interpretation; no physical action is required.
required_inputs: Validated OEM/UI product resource and property
safety_requirements: Use read-only FRU and API operations
Never write FRU or issue PATCH/raw mutations
Do not substitute BMC, BIOS, VBIOS or component firmware version
Stop on multiple product records or namespace ambiguity
agent_execution_scope: Bind the intended product FRU record
Resolve the validated OEM/UI product resource
Capture complete redacted responses and statuses
Compare with the authoritative product-version oracle
Report exact mismatch or unresolved namespace

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool fru print` can expose Product Version, but `/redfish/v1/Chassis/system` and `.Product.Version` are not validated. A missing-path fallback or raw string equality cannot prove the correct product-version namespace.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only access to capture the bound product FRU and validated OEM/UI Product Version, preserve the raw revision token and compare it with the approved product configuration record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `ipmitool fru list` inspection, Product Version field, UI agreement criterion and 2/0-minute timing are preserved; resource and version semantics are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a product-scoped comparator that records FRU/resource provenance, raw version token, configuration-reference version and normalization-policy version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds product-version identity and reference provenance instead of assuming an arbitrary JSON property is authoritative.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong product revision and namespace while retaining the intended read-only FRU/UI comparison.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Product, hardware-revision and firmware-version fields can look similar; broad normalization can hide a material revision mismatch.

project_override_considerations: Product Version is not automatically the BMC, BIOS, GPU VBIOS, board or chassis version. Private script behavior is unavailable and cannot establish that equivalence.
expected_evidence: Selected product FRU and OEM/UI resource
Complete redacted raw responses and statuses
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and prior reviews consistently target Product Version. Missing product mapping, expected value and revision semantics are finite execution inputs, not contradictory source meaning.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and comparison are clear. Product-resource mapping, expected version and interpretation policy can be supplied through the normal package path.

review_improvement: Prevents a component or firmware version, guessed API property or stripped revision token from being accepted as the product version.
independent_technical_reasoning: A product version can encode finished-system hardware/configuration revision and is not interchangeable with firmware or subassembly versions. The comparison must bind the same product object across FRU, UI and the configuration oracle, retaining meaningful suffixes. These are finite read-only prerequisites, so REQUIRES is appropriate rather than BLOCKED.
